title: last bimbo IS the internet. 👩🏻‍💻 @The New Group #thelastbimbooftheapo...
transcript: if you love millennial nostalgia internet chaos and pop culture references so unhinged they'll make you gasp you cannot miss the last Bimbo of the Apocalypse at The New Group Theater it's inspired by that 2006 infamous New York Post cover featuring Paris Hilton, Lindsay Lohan and Britney Spears the show though dives into a mystery hidden within the photo and the three Gen Z internet sleuths who want to uncover it I won't spoil anything but expect Deep dives into early 2000s drama Y2K fashion and an exploration of the toxic obsession with female fame it's part Investigative thriller part chaotic fever dream and part pop culture musical with music so catchy it might rewire your brain Pulitzer Prize finalists Michael Breslin and Patrick Foley are the twisted brilliant minds behind this and the cast is ridiculous especially Keri René Fuller who is giving peak 2000s diva and Natalie Walker who never fails to make me laugh-cry every time she’s on stage it's absolutely wild and meta and makes fun of Perez Hilton and it's running until June 1st go see the last bimbo of the apocalypse like right now go immediately
